title: 第1508章 讲故事自罚三杯第1507章 九玄宝匣玄机骰
content_zh:
笑声稍歇，火雀圣看向石人圣：“老石，轮到你了。”
石人圣沉默了数息，端起酒杯饮尽，方才缓缓开口：“我要讲的故事，发生在天河支流。”
他的声音低沉而厚重，一开口便将包间内仅存的笑意压了下去。
“那是两千年前，我乘宝船沿天河支流下行，准备前往北冥渊。船行至一片无名水域时，水面忽然暴起。一头巨大的水怪破浪而出，通体漆黑，形如巨蟒，却生着三颗头颅。每一颗头颅喷吐出的水箭，都能将虚空洞穿。”
火雀圣神色一凝：“天河支流确实蛰伏着不少上古凶兽，但三首蟒……这玩意儿至少是轮回境七重天以上的存在。”
“不止。”石人圣摇头，“当时宝船上有三位轮回境八重天的皇者坐镇。三人联手围攻那头水怪，却只撑了不到一炷香的时间，便尽数重伤。”
“什么？”赤风圣倒吸一口凉气。
轮回境八重天，在九霄大陆已是绝巅级别的存在。三位联手都不敌，那水怪该有多强？
“就在宝船即将被水怪掀翻之际。”石人圣的声音更低了，像是陷入了某种深沉的回忆，“水面忽然裂开。一个人——
不，应该说，一个无头的存在，从水底走了出来。”
“无头？”林玄眼神一凝。
“对，无头。”石人圣抬起头，目光中带着一丝难以言说的情绪，“他身高不过十米左右，通体肌肤呈灰白色，像是石头，又像是干涸的血肉。最醒目的是他脖颈处的断口——整齐平滑，像是被某种锋锐之物一刀斩断。他每往前走一步，天地便安静一分。等走到水怪面前时，整个天河支流都陷入了死一般的寂静，浪涛凝固在半空，水怪僵在原地，一动不动。”
包间内陷入死寂。
没有人说话，甚至连呼吸声都轻了下来。
“他缓缓伸出手，抓住了水怪中间那颗头颅，轻轻地，很轻，像是在摘一朵花。”石人圣缓缓抬起自己的手，模仿着那个动作，“然后，他将水怪整个塞进了自己断开的脖颈里。”
赤风圣喉咙滚动了一下，声音有些干涩：“塞进……脖子里？”
“对。”石人圣放下手，“水怪消失后，天地恢复如常。那位无头至尊在原地站了片刻，便转身走回了水底。至始至终，他没有发出任何声音，没有泄出一丝一毫的气息。但他走之后，宝船上三位皇者中的一位，忽然跪在甲板上痛哭失声。”
“为何？”雪空冥大圣轻声问。
“那位皇者说——那是人族的先辈。”石人圣闭上眼睛，“他身上穿的战甲样式，是上古神话时代的制式。那是人族最黑暗的年代，无数先辈战死沙场，尸骨无存。”
“后来，我查遍典籍，终于找到了关于无头至尊的零星记载。”石人圣睁开眼，“他存在于史书的缝隙之中。有人说他在天河徘徊了无数个纪元，有人说他在等待一个永远不会到来的命令，也有人说他早已死去，留在世间的只是一具执念不灭的躯壳。真正的答案，无人知晓。只知他是人族的古老前辈，可遇不可求。”

故事讲完，包间里久久没有人说话。
烛火摇曳，映照在每个人的脸上。
林玄闭上眼。
他仿佛看到了那个画面——一尊无头的尸体，在天河之底漫无目的地行走。一具没有头颅的身躯，却散发着让天地寂静的至尊气息。
他在走什么？在找什么？
是在找他的头，还是在找他的战旗，亦或是在找那些早已消逝在岁月长河中的袍泽？
那种孤独，那种无言的悲怆，像潮水一样从石人圣的故事里溢出，淹没了包间里的每一个人。
雪空冥大圣垂下了眼帘。
赤风圣沉默地看着面前的酒杯。
火雀圣伸手揉了揉眉心，良久不语。
足足过了半盏茶的时间。
林玄第一个睁开眼。他端起酒杯，朝向石人圣。
石人圣抬起头，对上了林玄的目光。
content_en:
After a pause in laughter, the Fire Bird Sage looked at the Stone Man Sage: "Old Shi, it's your turn."
The Stone Man Saint was silent for a few breaths, picked up the wine glass and drank it all, then slowly spoke: "The story I want to tell happened in a tributary of the Tianhe River."
His voice was low and thick, suppressing the remaining smile in the private room as soon as he spoke.
"That was two thousand years ago. I took a treasure boat down a tributary of the Tianhe River, preparing to go to the Northern Abyss. When the boat reached an unknown body of water, the water surface suddenly burst out. A huge water monster broke through the waves. It was completely black and shaped like a giant python, but it had three heads. The water arrows spewed from each head could pierce the void."
The fire sparrow saint's expression condensed: "There are indeed many ancient ferocious beasts dormant in the tributaries of the Tianhe River, but the three-headed python... this thing is at least an existence above the seventh heaven of the reincarnation realm."
"More than that." The Stone Man Saint shook his head, "At that time, there were three emperors from the eighth level of the reincarnation realm sitting on the treasure ship. The three of them teamed up to besiege the water monster, but they only lasted less than a stick of incense before they were all seriously injured."
"What?" Chifeng Sheng took a breath of cold air.
The eighth level of reincarnation realm is already an extremely top level existence in Jiuxiao Continent. If the three of them can't defeat each other together, how strong should the water monster be?
"Just when the treasure ship was about to be overturned by the water monster." The Stone Man Saint's voice was even lower, as if he was immersed in some deep memories, "The water surface suddenly split. A man——
No, it should be said that a headless existence came out of the water. "
"Headless?" Lin Xuan's eyes narrowed.
"Yes, headless." The Stoneman Saint raised his head, with a hint of unspeakable emotion in his eyes, "He is only about ten meters tall, and his skin is gray-white, like stone, but also like dried flesh. The most eye-catching thing is the fracture on his neck - neat Smooth, as if cut off by something sharp. Every time he took a step forward, the world became quieter. When he reached the water monster, the entire Tianhe tributary fell into a deathly silence, the waves froze in the air, and the water monster froze in place. "
The private room fell into dead silence.
No one spoke, even the breathing became softer.
"He slowly stretched out his hand and grabbed the head in the middle of the water monster, gently, very lightly, as if picking a flower." The Stoneman Saint slowly raised his hand, imitating the action, "Then, he stuffed the whole water monster into his severed neck."
Chifeng Sheng's throat rolled, and his voice was a little dry: "Stuff it into... your neck?"
"Yes." The Stoneman Saint put down his hand, "After the water monster disappeared, the world returned to normal. The headless Supreme stood there for a moment, then turned and walked back to the bottom of the water. From the beginning to the end, he did not make any sound or release a single breath. But after he left, one of the three emperors on the treasure ship suddenly knelt on the deck and cried bitterly."
"Why?" Great Sage Xue Kongming asked softly.
"The emperor said - that is the ancestor of the human race." The Stoneman Saint closed his eyes, "The armor style he wore was the standard of the ancient mythological era. It was the darkest age of the human race. Countless ancestors died in the battlefield, and no bones were left."
"Later, I searched through the classics and finally found sporadic records about the Headless Supreme." The Stoneman Saint opened his eyes, "He exists in the gaps in the history books. Some say that he has been wandering in the Tianhe for countless epochs, some say that he is waiting for an order that will never come, and some say that he has died long ago, and what is left in the world is only a body with immortal obsession. No one knows the real answer. We only know that he is an ancient predecessor of the human race, and he is rarely encountered."
After the story was told, no one spoke in the private room for a long time.
The candlelight flickered, reflecting on everyone's face.
Lin Xuan closed his eyes.
He seemed to see that scene - a headless corpse walking aimlessly at the bottom of the Milky Way. A body without a head, but it exudes the supreme aura that silences the world.
What is he walking about? What are you looking for?
yesAre you looking for his head, his battle flag, or those robes that have long disappeared in the long river of time?
That kind of loneliness, that kind of silent sadness, overflowed from the story of the Stone Man Saint like a tide, drowning everyone in the private room.
The Great Sage Xue Kongming lowered his eyes.
Chifeng Sheng looked at the wine glass in front of him in silence.
The Fire Bird Saint stretched out his hand and rubbed the center of his brow, and remained silent for a long time.
It took half a cup of tea.
Lin Xuan was the first to open his eyes. He picked up the wine glass and faced the Stone Man Saint.
The Stone Man Saint raised his head and met Lin Xuan's eyes.
